posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Yeah, Nightmist is cool for damage, though I tend to hurt stuff by using the Amulet to redirect damage when things try to hit me. Also when I use Oblivion, unless it's only one or two damage on the first card, I'll redirect the bit that would hit me onto another target. I don't actually use the Ring that often, since I like to use Investigate to get my cards out, and of course I'll be doing myself extra damage from that with the +1 from the ring. The way I play Nightmist, I don't really take much advantage of damage buffs. I tend to focus more on deck control and on getting cards out in order to achieve that. And to redirect stuff. And to heal off the Starshield Necklace if I don't have Master of Magic out yet. I suppose, basically, my tactic with Nightmist is to get as many cards as possible in my hand, but not so many that I can't look at the top couple from my deck when using stuff like Oblivion or Heedless Lash. That and get the Amulet and Necklace into play, and Astral Premonition. Pretty much everything else is there to be discarded when using stuff like the Necklace, Mistbound, etc.

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: The ring increases the damage that Nightmist deals.  Redirection only changes the target, it does not alter the source, so, since Nightmist is redirecting damage that is about to be dealt to her, if she wasn't dealing herself damage, she is not the source, and thus her damage modifiers do not apply.

posts.name: Zalrus9
posts.cooked:
Hey Guys!

 

Favorite Heroes:

I would say my favorite hero, style-wise is Absolute Zero. I am a sucker for knights in sour armor, and it's cool that there's a Mr. Freeze-like hero out there. Gameplay-wise, he's a bit of a slow start, but he can be awesome. (Kind of want to try out his promo version for more consistancy.)

My favorite Support Hero is the Argent Adept. Sure, his character is a bit on the bland side, but he's so versitile. I'm glad Greater than Games makes Bards that aren't so spooney!

 

I'm also big fans of Bunker, Visionary and Fanatic, but I'm a fan of diversity, so I'll go with anything.

 

Favorite Villians:

I'm thinking right now: The Ennead. I'm a bit of a sucker for Egyptian Mythology, and I do love the gameplay for them. Fighting a team of superpowered villians is pretty cool on the table!

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
Favorite heroes:

 

My absolute favorite is Nightmist, and Argent Adept is a close second.

Third is Mister Fixer.

Fourth is Absolute Zero, and fifth... probably Tachyon.

 

My favorite villains are the Ennead, Akash'Bhuta, Voss, and GloomWeaver.

 

My least favorite heroes are Bunker and Fanatic, and my least favorite villains are the Matriarch, Ambuscade, and the Chairman.

 

I LOVE the Realm of Discord and Insula Primalis. I dislike both Rook City environments and mars, and have a love-hate with Megalopolis, Atlantis, and the Tomb of Anubis.
